tr_steps_sum: How to use: send files to another device (tap to open)
tr_step1: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi (a phone hotspot for the computer is fine).
tr_step2: Pick which device receives: on that one tap Generate my code - a 6-digit number appears.
tr_step3: On the other device (the sender) type those 6 digits in the pairing box and tap Pair.
tr_step4: When paired, This device and Other device both show a green dot.
tr_step5: Tap Photos / Files / Folder to choose what to send (on desktop you can drag files or a whole folder in).
tr_step6: Tap Send and wait for the progress to finish. Stay on this page - do not close it or switch apps.
tr_step7: The other device saves automatically (iPhone shows Save to Photos, Android saves to Downloads).
tr_step8: Transfer has its own free quota, counted separately from downloads (each has its own daily allowance); paid members are unlimited.
tr_steps_note: Files never pass through our server, are not compressed or converted, and are verified with SHA-256. Keep both devices on this page until it finishes.

doc_terms_body:
1. What this service is

Ferry (scefo.com) provides online tools for downloading media you are entitled to access and for lossless transfer between your own devices. It is a tool only: we do not upload, keep or store whatever you resolve or transfer.

2. Accounts

Registration requires a valid email address. Keep your password safe. Accounts are for personal use only and may not be rented, transferred or shared.

3. Acceptable use

  • Personal backup and fair use only. Do not use the service to infringe copyright or for any unlawful purpose.
  • Do not distribute, redistribute or sell content you obtained through the service.
  • Do not bypass paid content or DRM, and do not overload the service with automated bulk requests.
  • We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

4. Paid plans and activation

Monthly NT$88 (30 days); Lifetime NT$988 (one-time). Membership is activated automatically after payment. Price changes do not apply retroactively to previous purchases.

5. Usage limits

Free users get a daily allowance (reset at 00:00 in your local time zone). Paid members have unlimited downloads and transfers while their membership is active.

6. Changes, maintenance and downtime

Third-party platform policies, technical limits or maintenance may require us to change supported platforms or features, or to pause the service. We will give notice whenever possible.

7. Intellectual property

The software, interface, trademarks and text of this service belong to us or our licensors. You receive only a right to use the service under these Terms.

8. Disclaimer

You are responsible for confirming that the content you download is legal for you to use. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service.

9. Termination

You may delete your account at any time from the Member page. We may disable accounts that breach these Terms.

10. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of China (Taiwan). Disputes are subject to the first-instance jurisdiction of the New Taipei District Court, Taiwan.
doc_privacy_body:
1. What we collect

  • Registration: email address, nickname, password (stored as a one-way hash).
  • Usage: sign-in times, free-quota usage, device identifier, IP address (for quota counting and abuse prevention).
  • Payment: order number, plan, amount and payment status (card numbers are handled by the payment provider and never reach us).

2. What we do NOT collect

We never download, copy or store the media you resolve or transfer. Your download history stays in your own browser (local storage).

3. Why we use it

To provide the service, count free usage, activate memberships and send notices, prevent abuse, and improve quality.

4. Cookies and local storage

We use browser local storage for language preference, device identifier, sign-in token and download history. Clearing browser data removes them.

5. Third parties

Payments are processed by our payment provider (e.g. NewebPay) under its own privacy policy. If advertising is enabled, ad partners may use cookies under their policies. We never sell or trade your personal data.

6. Security and retention

Data is stored on protected servers and transmitted over encrypted connections. We delete or anonymise data when it is no longer needed.

7. Your rights

You may access, correct or delete your data: delete your account from the Member page, or email a42599@gmail.com.

8. Minors

If you are under 18, please use the service with the consent of a parent or guardian.

9. Changes to this policy

Updates are published on this page together with a new last-updated date.
doc_refund_body:
1. Refund process (5 steps)

  1. You email us at a42599@gmail.com with (1) account email, (2) order number, (3) payment method and time, (4) reason.
  2. We confirm within 1-2 business days and reply with the result.
  3. We file it with the provider within 1-3 business days (NewebPay back office).
  4. The provider processes it: card refunds are handled by NewebPay and your issuing bank and usually appear within 7-14 business days.
  5. Done: your membership returns to the free plan and we notify you by email.

For ATM or convenience-store payments we refund by bank transfer to the account you provide, within about 3-7 business days.

2. When a full refund is available

  • Within 7 days of payment and no paid feature has been used (0 downloads and 0 transfers).
  • Duplicate charges, system errors, or payment completed without activation.

3. When a refund is not available

  • The paid feature has been used (you already downloaded or transferred): this is a digital service supplied instantly, which falls under the reasonable exception to the 7-day right of withdrawal (Article 19, Consumer Protection Act).
  • Problems caused by your own device, network, or changes in third-party platform policies - we will help you troubleshoot, but this is not a refund reason.
  • The account was suspended for breaching the Terms of Service.

4. Processing times at a glance

  • Our confirmation: 1-2 business days
  • Filed with the provider: 1-3 business days
  • Card refund credited: 7-14 business days (depends on the issuing bank)
  • ATM / convenience-store refund by transfer: 3-7 business days

5. Fees

Payment-processing fees charged by the provider may be deducted from the refunded amount where applicable; we will tell you beforehand.

6. Disputes

If you disagree with the outcome, email us again and we will help check with the payment provider.

plans_fx_list: This service is priced in New Taiwan dollars (TWD). The price shown (NT$88 / NT$988) is the amount we charge.
Your issuing bank converts TWD into your local currency at the exchange rate in effect at the moment of payment. Your statement is the final amount.
Most banks add a foreign transaction fee of about 1%-2%. Rules differ by bank - please check with your card issuer.
Paying via Alipay / WeChat Pay etc.
If you pay through a third-party payment platform, its own exchange rate and fees at that moment apply.
Why we do not show a fixed rate
Exchange rates change every day and each bank or card network converts at a different moment, so we do not hard-code a number - we only link to the official converters for reference.
